title: Discriminating test for the card update-path compaction flag clear during an otherwise unchanged rescan
outcome: A test shows that when a carded run's card turns terminal during a rescan whose index diff is empty (for example a failure-excerpt retry on a Failed run whose earlier read was Unavailable, or a card that was Cold during the pass that changed the run), the became_terminal clear of compaction_examined_revision in update_test_run_card_locked (src/test_run_cards.rs) makes that same pass select and compact the run. Removing the clear must turn the test red.
acceptance: A focused test fails when the became_terminal clear in update_test_run_card_locked is removed and passes with it, and it asserts compaction of an over-limit run in the same rescan that flips its card terminal with an empty index diff.
